hero.subtitle: Verified Travelers have spare room in their luggage: your parcel arrives faster, cheaper, and hand-delivered.
hero.illustrationAlt: Illustration: a parcel traveling in a Traveler's luggage
hero.travelerLink: Traveling soon? Make your spare kilos pay

corridors.label: Right now
corridors.title: Travelers are leaving soon
corridors.subtitle: These trips are published and bookable today — tap a route to see the departures.

find.title: Find a trip
find.description: Search your destination: Travelers heading there show their date, available kilos and price.

book.title: Book
book.description: You pay when you book, but the money stays held by Stripe until delivery.

handoff.title: Hand over your parcel
handoff.description: You arrange the meetup in Yamba's messaging, before the Traveler departs.

delivered.title: It's delivered
delivered.description: Your recipient gives the confidential code at handover — only you know it. The money is then released.

publish.title: Publish your trip
publish.description: Destination, date, available kilos, your price per kilo: it takes two minutes.

accept.title: Accept requests
accept.description: You see the declared contents and choose what you carry — nothing is forced on you.

deliver.title: Carry and deliver
deliver.description: You hand over the parcel against the delivery code: that's your proof of delivery.

paid.title: Get your earnings
paid.description: After delivery, your earnings are paid out to your account — the payment was secured from the booking.

trust.label: Trust and safety
trust.title: Your parcel is in good hands.
trust.subtitle: No empty promises: these are the mechanisms protecting every shipment.

escrow.title: The money is held
escrow.description: Paid at booking, held in escrow by Stripe, released to the Traveler only after delivery.

code.title: The delivery code
code.description: Six digits only you know: without it, the handover isn't validated and the money doesn't move.

verified.title: Verified profiles and tickets
verified.description: Identity checked through Stripe, transport tickets verifiable — the badge shows it on every trip.

support.title: A team when things go wrong
support.description: Reporting, mediation and refunds under the cancellation policy, right inside the app.

pricing.promise: The price you see is the price you pay.
pricing.detail: The Traveler sets their price per kilo; the total you see includes Yamba's service. No hidden fees, no subscription.

finalCta.subtitle: Send your first parcel, or publish your next trip.

shipper.title: Shipper
shipper.description: Your parcel travels with someone already going — faster and cheaper than standard shipping.

yamber.title: Traveler
yamber.description: Already traveling? The spare kilos in your luggage can pay for part of your ticket.
